identity.title: Adjudicate the operator-approved wreq transport exception

authorization.reference: After reviewing the measured WP-007 blockers and dependency alternatives, the Operator said: "ok lets go for your recommended path". This authorizes the recommended narrow BoringSSL-backed wreq and wreq-util exception for a bounded non-shipped dependency-adjudication integration, including an exact-pinned wreq 6.0.0-rc.29 candidate and stable wreq 5.3.0 control. It does not authorize product promotion, a general native-dependency exception, ambient proxy use, automatic redirect/cookie authority, transparent decompression, curl, curl-impersonate, Python, yt-dlp, or a browser runtime.

lifecycle.next_action: Implement the exact-pinned stable control and v6 release-candidate wreq adapters behind the retained WP-007 capability boundary, then run behavior-sensitive dependency, wire, security, and resource validation.

scope.summary: Use the Operator-approved narrow BoringSSL exception to adjudicate wreq as Ferric's fingerprint-capable transport candidate without promoting the experiment into shipped product code.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: FF-DEC-001 records and mechanically enforces the Operator's narrow exception: only the non-shipped fforager-transport package may directly use exact-pinned wreq/wreq-util and their exact audited native-link surface; product use, unlisted consumers, version drift, extra native links, build downloads, prebuilt binaries, and promotion without a new Operator decision are rejected.

A reproducible stable wreq 5.3.0 control and exact-pinned wreq 6.0.0-rc.29 candidate are both compiled and exercised through the same bounded candidate contract; the selected result records exact features, browser-profile coverage, native/link/build surface, observed capabilities, failures, and rejected version with no production-selection claim.

The retained adapter blocks execution when requested fingerprint/profile capability is unavailable; disables ambient proxies, automatic redirects, internal cookie authority, and transparent decompression; preserves Ferric-owned policy inputs; and emits typed diagnostics that distinguish configured profile, negotiated protocol, peer/proxy evidence, executed wire proof, and skipped semantic dependencies.

Behavior-sensitive local and opt-in live probes cover browser TLS/HTTP2 fingerprint evidence, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 negotiation, bounded streaming, timeout, cancellation, proxy/address evidence limitations, profile and pool partitioning, secret sanitization, failure handling, and a declaration-preserving counterfactual that the same oracle rejects.

Cargo metadata, dependency policy, cargo-deny, source/build-script inspection, clean-artifact inspection, and supported-host builds record the exact direct/transitive/native surface and reject unauthorized dependency, consumer, feature, source, native-link, build-download, and prebuilt-binary mutations.

The adjudication emits PASS_WREQ_ADJUDICATION or FAILED_WREQ_ADJUDICATION_REQUIRES_OPERATOR_DECISION; either verdict states exact residual blockers, retains the prerequisite zero-progress ceiling, and does not authorize product promotion.

High-risk adversarial review records diff attack surfaces, at least two independent checks, counterfactuals, boundary probes, negative paths, findings, remediations, and residual uncertainty across transport security, resource/lifecycle, and native build/supply-chain lenses; every confirmed finding becomes a public-boundary regression and the full matrix reruns.

The no-context model manual explains the exact adjudication command, dependency exception scope, opt-in live-network boundary, report fields, failure reproduction, security/resource controls, and the prohibition on treating this prerequisite as shipped behavior.

high_roi_additions.gap_closed: The current gate only accepts an empty exception list and rejects every native link without an authorized narrow path.
